about: Every model a Blender script builds (M10, E315; docs/design/blender-practice.md). The script is the source, the GLB it exports is committed, a .blend never is. Run a target from the repo root with `bash node_modules/@wildshard/sdk/scripts/blender/build.sh <target>`, check one against its committed GLB with `--check`. Fields: script (the Blender entry, run with --python-exit-code 1), args, pre (shell, before Blender), sources (every other file the target needs: the SDK's scripts/check-model-sources.mjs refuses a file under src/blender/ that no target names), inputs (committed files it reads), lock (Cycles work: take the model lock), build (files Blender must leave in $BUILD), meshopt / copy ([build file, repo file] pairs), post (shell, after the copies), outputs (the committed files it makes), feeds (the code that loads them), manual (not buildable here: why), check (the command --check runs for a manual target).

far-reach/roc.about: Sky Reach's Storm Roc repair (E392/E399 council round 13): Hunyuan3D-2's eagle (art/far-reach/round-27-roc) with its loose second-head lump deleted, its open edges filled, the claw shapes painted on its tail fan painted out and its beak and toes pushed to gold; then meshopt + a 1024 WebP map (art/far-reach/round-31-roc-fix)
far-reach/roc.manual: the source is Hunyuan3D-2's output after finish.sh (~/ml/img2mesh/work/roc-eagle/roc-eagle.raw.glb), which is not committed: run repair.py on it, then gltf-transform optimize <out> src/static/assets/far-reach/models/roc-hd/roc-hd.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024 --simplify false --instance false
